Part 2. Information Technology

Chapter 8. Audit Information Management System (AIMS)

Section 9. AIMS Command Code AMRET

2.8.9 AIMS Command Code AMRET

Manual Transmittal

October 07, 2026

Purpose

(1) This transmits revised IRM 2.8.9, Audit Information Management System (AIMS), AIMS Command Code AMRET.

Material Changes

(1) IRM 2.8.9.1 Revised Internal Controls to adhere to mandatory format.

(2) IRM 2.8.9 Tables updated throughout to be Section 508 compliant.

Effect on Other Documents

IRM 2.8.9, dated December 11, 2024, is superseded.

Audience

This IRM is intended for the general use of IDRS system personnel from all four Business Operating Divisions (Taxpayer Services (TS), Small Business/Self-Employed (SB/SE), Large Business and International (LB&I) and Tax-Exempt Government Entities (TE/GE)) and Appeals accessing the Audit Information Management System.

Effective Date

(01-01-2027)


Kaschit Pandya
Chief Information Officer

Roles and Responsibilities

  1. Headquarters AIMS Related Section is responsible for maintaining procedures related to AIMS programming.
